elements.body: Locum tenens assignment booking, pipeline & contract performance

name.text: Avg Bill Rate vs Pay Rate by Specialty

elements.body: **Data notes:** Estimated Contract Value = Bill Rate × Assignment LOA (days) × 8 hrs/shift. Cancellation reason and facility type are not present in this POC extract, so they aren't broken out below. \~38% of records have no Worksite State captured (mostly on-site "Regular" assignments, not just Telehealth) — shown as *(Not Captured)* rather than hidden.
Specialty × status volume and governed assignment detail
